grabber.description: Core sensor driver. Provides software access to all physical sensors on the Sensing Robot: GiGE Camera, ATI F/T Sensor, Teensy Accelerometer, Camera Light Controller, buttons, and ToF range finders.

impacts.characteristic: Usage of a different GiGE camera
impacts.what_changes: Camera (Sony XCG-CP510) selected. ARAVIS SDK is compatible with all GigE Vision cameras so no software change is required for standard GiGE swaps. For non-standard types (thermal, hyperspectral) additional investigation may be needed outside this characteristic.
Capture resolution set to 2464.0×2056.0 px. Update --size flag and params.yaml width/height accordingly. Higher resolutions increase storage and processing load.
Target frame rate: 23.0 Hz. RAM-backed storage (--ram) is required at this frame rate. Update --fps flag and params.yaml frame_rate.
Camera frames will be published to POSIX shared memory stream 'stream1' (--stream flag). File output is disabled when streaming. Required for the live vision classifier.

impacts.characteristic: Addition of more lights for better illumination
impacts.what_changes: Extra LED units can be connected to spare channels on the existing Camera Light Controller. Minor update to Arduino_Thread process to activate additional channels. Camera exposure must be recalibrated for the new lighting conditions.

flags.message: Frame rate 23.0 Hz > 10 Hz requires RAM-backed storage. Ensure --ram flag is set in launch args.
Changes span 4 module(s). Phased integration and cross-module testing is strongly recommended.

orienteering_solver.description: Generates optimal schedules for cleaning robots to address defects. Determines the sequence of defects to visit and service time to spend on each. Problem variants: OP (default), TSP, TOP (multi-arm), OPTW (time windows), OPVP (variable profit).

localiser.description: Publishes the pose of a workpiece mesh relative to the robot base in the ROS2 TF2 framework. Foundational for motion planning. A calibrated Setup is registered once (operator + robot, requires a mesh) and then republished at runtime as static or slider-corrected dynamic TF — no mesh is needed once a Setup is registered.

impacts.what_changes: Surface material(s): metal. If a new Setup still needs registering for this workpiece, mesh availability (Q7) determines whether Registration can proceed.
Mesh in preparation (Status unknown). If this Setup isn't registered yet, Registration is blocked until the mesh is finalized; an already-registered Setup is unaffected.
Localiser can run more exhaustive search and refinement cycles. Time deadline check within the Localiser can be removed or relaxed, potentially improving localization accuracy.

flags.message: Registering a new Localiser Setup is blocked until the mesh is available. Revisit this assessment when the mesh is ready.
Changes span 4 module(s). Phased integration and cross-module testing is strongly recommended.

tactile_sensor.description: Detects and classifies surface defects using tactile probe data (force, acceleration). CNN-LSTM / LSTM-CNN ensemble model. Must be retrained whenever materials, object sizes, or defect types change.

vision_classifier.description: Visual defect detection and classification using camera images. Implicitly affected when new materials are introduced — model must be retrained and the Vision Model Name parameter in the Configuration Module must be updated.

impacts.characteristic: (implicit) Retrain vision model on material data
impacts.what_changes: Vision Classifier model must be retrained on images of: metal. This also applies to materials MAGICIAN already tests: the shapes and geometry of your objects may differ from the baseline. Update Vision Model Name parameter in the Configuration Module after retraining.
impacts.reason: Q5: Material(s) selected — vision retraining required

flags.message: Material selected — vision classifier must be retrained on data covering this material and your object shapes.
Changes span 4 module(s). Phased integration and cross-module testing is strongly recommended.

ergodic_control.description: Plans inspection trajectories that prioritise high-risk surface regions. Uses a Kalman filter to maintain a belief over defect distributions, combines historical data and welding process priors, then solves an ergodic control optimisation to generate end-effector waypoints on the 3D mesh.

impacts.what_changes: Mesh is not yet available. Configure the mesh path in the Ergodic Control module config tab once the mesh is ready.
No time budget specified — dense trajectory mode is available. Consider setting a high time budget in the Ergodic Control configuration to maximise surface coverage.
Target materials: metal. Defect types: surface_damage. The Ergodic Control prior distribution is seeded from this context — re-run compute to regenerate trajectory and Kalman configs.
impacts.reason: Q5/Q8: Material or defect types specified

flags.message: 3D mesh is in preparation — configure the mesh path before running compute.
Changes span 4 module(s). Phased integration and cross-module testing is strongly recommended.

motion_planning.description: Converts target poses or Cartesian paths into time-sampled end-effector references. Transforms poses through TF, optionally projects paths onto workpiece meshes, assigns surface-normal orientations, applies velocity limits, and selects impedance/admittance control and sander state.
